clock.formula: host_ns = qpc * 1e9 / frequency + offset; retain both bounds

limits: Individual closed owner/waiter mechanisms only; counts are not time shares. GUI painting or reply parsing at an instant does not measure whole native-call GIL hold time or identify the severe OFF cases cause.
This new window is not a replacement for any OFF/failed window. Late completion/cadence failures stay failures; all20 samples including out-of-window rows retained.
Unmatched native modules keep original module/SHA/RVA; no kernel stack or scheduling state attribution. No-owner/empty Python frames remain explicit.

Replay reader/video thread paths are experimental and cannot be relabeled as the formal USB/camera reader. SDK native threads belong to another PID/GIL; GUI-side reply decoding is a separate main-process path.
